title: Comparison: PFRDA vs RBI vs SEBI vs IRDAI

blocks.content: Each regulatory body in India operates under a distinct statutory mandate to ensure financial stability, market integrity, and consumer protection across their respective sectors.

items: RBI was established on April 1, 1935, under the Reserve Bank of India Act, 1934, and was nationalized in 1949.
SEBI was given statutory status in 1992 through the SEBI Act following the Harshad Mehta scam.
IRDAI headquarters are located in Hyderabad, Telangana (relocated from New Delhi in 2001).
PFRDA achieved statutory status with the passage of the PFRDA Act in 2013.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: RBI oversees monetary policy, currency issuance, and banking regulation in India.
SEBI regulates capital markets, stock exchanges, and protects investor interests.
IRDAI regulates insurance company licensing, policyholder interests, and industry solvency norms.
PFRDA regulates the pension market, including the National Pension System (NPS) and Atal Pension Yojana (APY).
